results.title: Seattle Kraken fan guide: Five do’s and don’ts as 2026-27 season begins
results.description: The Kraken's 2026-27 season begins Thursday night with a road game against the Calgary Flames. Seattle has missed the playoffs three straight seasons and little is expected of this one as well.

results.description: The Week 5 schedule in college football has major matchups across the country. We break down the biggest ones.

results.title: ‘Finger is ugly’ – Mike Brown pokes fun at Josh Hart’s injury while praising the player’s toughness
results.description: New York Knicks head coach Mike Brown decided to take a light-hearted approach while heaping praise on Josh Hart’s toughness as it was revealed that he was playing through a finger injury. The Knicks player took to X and shared an update on his injury, where Hart confirmed that he does not plan to have another surgery and will play with his finger wrapped for the rest of his career.

results.title: Nebraska announces players at Big Ten Basketball Media Day
results.description: Nebraska revealed the players who are accompanying Fred Hoiberg for Big Ten Basketball Media Day. Pryce Sandfort and Braden Frager will join Hoiberg.
